purpose: Ten independent style directions: flat emblems, typographic wordmarks, material explorations and a native application-icon concept. Opaque concept artboards; no application assets replaced.

concepts.name: 黑白通口
concepts.meaning: 实心 D 内切出一条折返通路，连接首字母与远程命令通道。
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Brand: DockShell, an original macOS SSH terminal application. The name combines Dock (a place for independent remote sessions to dock) and Shell (a command terminal). It offers SSH connections, separate session tabs, and equal horizontal or vertical terminal splits.
Create one highly resolved ORIGINAL brand concept on one square artboard, not a contact sheet or a UI screenshot. The requested style below must strongly determine the visual language. A strong silhouette and intentional negative space matter more than decoration. Show one primary identity, with generous margins. Do not imitate any existing brand or commercial terminal application. No watermarks, captions, numbering, slogans, stock padlocks, shields, cables, server racks, anchors, ships or extra decorative icons. Do not attach a generic wordmark unless specifically requested. No need to show every feature; use the single named metaphor.

Style: radical black-and-white geometric counterform logo, flat vector-like identity.
Subject: a single dense uppercase D silhouette, straight vertical left side and smoothly curved right side, with an asymmetric S-shaped open channel carved all the way through it from upper-left to lower-right. The white channel must be extremely simple, two broad right-angle turns, optical balance, no arrowhead and no enclosed letter counter. The void is a passage through a dock, the outside still reads D. NOT a D sliced into equal horizontal halves. Strong carved graphic tension, almost a typographic sculpture but completely flat. Pure black on clean white. One emblem only, centered, no words, no gradients or texture. Aim for a memorable single-color application mark, not an abstract maze.

Style: restrained architectural monoline brand identity, thin but confident weight and large open spaces.
Subject: an original open harbor emblem made from a single precise squared U-shaped path turned onto its side, with one interior 90-degree return, suggesting a docking berth and a lowercase d without drawing a literal letter. A single copper circular connection point sits at the entrance and is the only accent. Charcoal hairline on warm ivory. The emblem should look like a clean engineering drawing without grids, measurements or labels, enough line weight to remain readable. Small exact text "DockShell" set beneath in subtly letterspaced humanist sans serif, quiet and light, not oversized. Compact mark in a spacious editorial composition. Style: sophisticated low-resolution pixel identity, intentionally coarse pixels on a strict square grid, contemporary rather than nostalgic gaming.
Subject: an original compact lowercase ds monogram constructed from chunky equal square pixels, one joined stepped silhouette with clearly open d counter and simplified s return. Deep ultramarine and one signal-orange docking pixel, on very pale blue. Style: heavy industrial stencil monogram, uncompromising graphic geometry, no sports or gaming aggression.
Subject: original uppercase DS ligature, upright not italic, constructed from two thick squared forms sharing a central vertical spine and a single uniform horizontal open slot passing through both at the same height. D on the left, S on the right both must be discernible. Two or three broad stencil masses, chamfered internal corners, tiny outer-corner radii. The slot references evenly divided terminal panes, the letter joint references a dock. Bright acid-yellow ink on dark graphite, flat single color without material effects. Huge centered monogram only, no accompanying wordmark, no frame, no wings, no lightning bolt, no shield or military badge. Visually resolved, boldly simple.
revision_prompts:
Use case: text-localization / logo letterform correction.
Edit the supplied logo concept, preserving the acid-yellow color, graphite background, overall industrial block weight, large centered composition, chamfered corners and the right-hand S.
The left glyph currently reads B. Correct it to an unmistakable uppercase D with ONE SINGLE tall open dark counter, not two compartments. Remove the horizontal yellow crossbar that divides the inside of the left letter into top and bottom holes. Use a single continuous dark interior opening in the D. Its outer left stroke remains straight and strong, and its right side is an octagonal rounded bowl. The center slot on the RIGHT letter S may remain; DO NOT run a horizontal slot or dividing bar through the D. The result must plainly read "DS", never "BS", "B6", "86" or "PS". Prioritize correct letter recognition above preserving the old center-slot idea.
Exactly one flat DS monogram, no additional text or symbols, no framing. Clean edges, same palette and background.

Use case: precise-object-edit, logo letterform correction.
Preserve the supplied composition, colors, background, weight and the LEFT D completely. Correct ONLY the RIGHT glyph, which currently resembles the numeral 6.
It must be a clear uppercase S with NO enclosed holes. Open the lower-left side of the right-hand glyph: carve a broad dark horizontal opening from its lower dark counter straight out to its left boundary. Remove the yellow lower-left connecting stem so the bottom counter connects with the outside graphite background. A true S has upper-right and lower-left OPENINGS, a top bowl opening right and a bottom bowl opening left. Ensure BOTH of those openings are broad and plainly visible. Retain the right outer lower stroke and bottom horizontal foot. The two letters must read DS, not D6. Exactly two upright industrial uppercase letters, no shared crossbar, no additional text, no extra objects. Acid yellow on graphite, same centered placement.

横向字标，适合官网与品牌展示；需单独提炼小图标。
